label: Mental health and addiction help, 24 hours (DWIHN, Wayne County)
internal_note: DWIHN's ACCESS line: 24/7 crisis line and the front door for publicly funded drug and alcohol treatment in all of Wayne County (research 2026-09-19, docs/research/2026-09-19-new-help/treatment-2-system-and-data.md). Some provider pages print wrong DWIHN numbers (800-421-4949, 800-231-1127, 800-841-4949); use only DWIHN's own pages.

label: Domestic violence hotline
internal_note: Text START to 88788.

label: National drug and alcohol helpline (SAMHSA)
internal_note: Free, 24/7, English and Spanish. TTY 1-800-487-4889. Text a ZIP code to 435748 (English only). Read on the owner page 2026-09-19.

label: Sexual assault help, 24 hours (Avalon Healing Center)
internal_note: Printed as 313-474-SAFE. Formerly Wayne County SAFE; free exams and advocates for all ages. Asks survivors to call first and does not publish its exam sites. Its /contact/ page has a tap-to-call link that dials 313-475-7233 (a bug on their page; tell Avalon, never copy that link).

label: Michigan sexual assault hotline (VOICES4), call or text
internal_note: Statewide, 24/7, anonymous. TTY 517-381-8470. The MDHHS Wayne County directory lists a different text number (866-238-1454); both owner pages (michigan.gov/voices4, mcedsv.org/hotline) say text 855-864-2374.

label: Walk in any time: DWIHN Care Center, 707 W. Milwaukee, Detroit
internal_note: 24/7 walk-in crisis unit for mental health or substance use; no ID, insurance or appointment needed (DWIHN). A crisis unit, not a detox. Also listed as sal_dwihn_care_center (health.mental).

label: Housing help, weekdays (Oakland County)
internal_note: Community Housing Network, the Housing Resource Center that is Oakland County's intake for housing help (HARA; research 2026-09-24). NOT 24 hours: calls and texts Mon-Fri 8:30am-4:30pm, closed on holidays; text the word "housing". The page says it gives no emergency housing and sends urgent needs to 2-1-1. Toll-free 866-282-3119 on the same page. The county's own Oakland Connects Helpline (800-848-5533, weekdays) is the alternate: oaklandcountymi.gov/community/neighborhood-housing-development/help-with-housing/emergency-housing-support.

label: Housing crisis help (Macomb County)
internal_note: Macomb Community Action, intake for the Macomb County Continuum of Care (MI-503), on the CoC's own page (research 2026-09-24). Hours are not stated; do not call it 24 hours. The county's own MCA pages list only 586-469-6999 and 586-469-5100.

label: Mental health and addiction help, 24 hours (OCHN, Oakland County)
internal_note: Oakland Community Health Network's own 24/7 crisis line; calls, chats or texts (research 2026-09-24). OCHN took crisis services in-house in mid-February 2026 (its news post of 2026-01-12); Common Ground still publishes its old number 800-231-1127 as its own Crisis Hub. oaklandchn.org answers scripts with HTTP 406, so check:emergency logs it as unreadable: a person checks it in a browser.

label: Mental health crisis help, 24 hours (MCCMH, Macomb County)
internal_note: Macomb County Community Mental Health crisis line: 24/7, for everyone regardless of income or insurance, translation available (research 2026-09-24). The main line 855-996-2264 is 8am-8pm and is not the crisis line.

label: Sexual assault help, 24 hours (HAVEN, Oakland County)
internal_note: HAVEN's 24-hour crisis support line, printed 248.334.1274; toll-free 877-922-1274 (research 2026-09-24). HAVEN also runs a domestic-violence shelter: never record an address for it anywhere (CLAUDE.md).

label: Sexual assault and abuse help, 24 hours (Turning Point, Macomb County)
internal_note: Turning Point's 24/7/365 hotline for sexual violence, domestic violence and trafficking; "anyone from anywhere can call" (research 2026-09-24). Its site shows addresses: never copy one here or anywhere (CLAUDE.md).
